en:
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.

<CLT=cltMIND>If I had only realized
it at the time...

<CLT=cltMIND>A RC helicopter...
So this place even has stuff like this...

<CLT=cltMIND>A high jump crossbar...
...It doesn't seem particularly useful.

<CLT=cltMIND>They could've just kept this in the
gym's storage. Why is it here?

<CLT=cltMIND>There're hurdles here... Can't imagine
we'd ever get a chance to use them.
